lines.t: The Day Grows Dark and Silent
Shadows stretch upon the land, a voice crying from the watchman, calling sons and daughters, take your stand.
Mercy pulls away, the earth is shaking, division sweeps through every nation, trumpet sounds for all who hear.
The line is drawn, the end is near
Awake, oh sleepers, hear the warning
The line is drawn, the time is near
The world is trembling in the morning
Let every heart behold in fear
Blow the trumpet through the heavens
Let the remnant stand apart
Love and wrath descend together
Truth now strikes the hardened heart
Foundations crack, the towers fall
Proud men cling to fading idols
Blind to justice, so in woe
Hope reserved for humble spirits
Bowing low, calling His name
Trumpet reaches every corner
Judgment falls, but mercy reigns
Harvest comes for those who listen
Fire cleanses those who stray
Choices made and lines are measured
Everything old swept away
Trumpet calls for war and healing
A final chance to turn and see
A garden waits for those believing
The lion roars for victory
Awake, O sleepers, hear the warning
A line is drawn, the time is near
Repentant hearts find shelter for me
Prideful ones dissolve in fear
Blow the trumpet through the heavens
Let the remnant stand apart
Mercy waits while wrath is pouring
Love and truth now cleanse the heart
Oh-oh-oh-oh-oh-oh Oh-oh-oh-oh-oh-oh
Thunder shakes the nations
Mountains bow before the King
Trumpet marks the ending
We'll restart
Creation sings
Oh, oh, oh, oh
